description: Use this when the user shares a link to a clothing product page and asks what it's made of, whether it contains polyester or other synthetics, whether it's 100% cotton, or how sustainable it is, for example "what is this shirt made of? <link>". Returns Greener Closet's stored fiber breakdown and score when the product is in its catalog. Otherwise it returns a link where the user can analyze the product on greenercloset.com. Do not use this for pasted label text (use check_fabric_label) or for a product described without a URL.

url.description: The full product page URL, e.g. https://www.patagonia.com/product/...

name: check_product
title: Check a clothing product
